I don’t know about you but I don’t have a whole lot of space for all my favorite kitchen appliances. Multifunctional devices such as the Ninja CrushBOSS 4-in-1 Blender can help you prepare your food and smoothies while taking less space. It ships with a 72oz pitcher and 26oz tumbler. Its processor has chopping, slicing and dicing capability. It has a large chute, so you can add your ingredients more conveniently. With its dicing kit, you can process 3 potatoes in 30 seconds.

More gadgets like this: here

This machine also has a SmoothSense program that adjusts speed and time automatically. It can also detect whether you are blending using a single serve or larger vessel. Here are the main specs:

  • 1850w motor base
  • 72oz XL pitcher, 26oz tumbler
  • 8-cup processor bowl
  • Multiblade for veggies and cheese
  • Dough blade for heavy dough

This machine has stacked blades and a curved pitcher, so you won’t have as many dead zones as other machines. The menu has presets for you to choose from. It supports 6 languages.
